Services arriving to the city will end trips at Park St Town Hall Stand J (2000425).
  • From 7pm to 4am buses will start and end trips at Hyde Park at St Marys Rd and College St. See the Hyde Park Interchange map.
  • From 11pm to 4am: route 311 buses will end trips at Museum Station Down Centre, Elizabeth St Stand A (200074). Buses leaving the city will pick up from Oxford St opposite Brisbane St.
  • In Vaucluse, from 3pm until 2am Vaucluse Rd will be one-way northbound only between New South Head Rd and Wentworth Rd. Route 325 buses to Vaucluse will detour via Fitzwilliam Rd, Wentworth Rd, Hopetoun Ave and New South Head Rd. Some stops will be missed. Buses leaving Vaucluse will run as normal.
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Sydney New Year’s Eve event page.

  • The 20:25 Bathurst to Lithgow service will now depart Bathurst at 7.22pm, Tarana 7.54pm, Rydal 8.10pm and arriving at Lithgow 8.29pm.

urlText: L1 and L2/L3 lines partial line closures for New Year’s Eve
content:
L1, L2 and L3 light rail services will be impacted as follows on New Year’s Eve, Tuesday 31 December, due to road closures in the city and for the safety of crowds:
 
L1 Dulwich Hill Line:
  • L1 light rail services run from 5am on New Year’s Eve and will be extended until 4am on New Year's Day.
  • From Central Grand Concourse, change for trains or metro services to continue your trip to your vantage point.
  • From 8pm to 2.30am, L1 services will not run between Convention and Central Grand Concourse due to expected large crowds and road closures; continue on foot to Central for train, metro and bus connections. L1 services will continue running between Convention and Dulwich Hill.
  • From 2.30am to 4am, L1 services will resume running between Central Grand Concourse and Dulwich Hill.
     
L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line:
  • L2 and L3 light rail services run from 5am on New Year’s Eve and will be extended until 4am on New Year's Day.
  • From 2pm to 7pm, L2 and L3 services will not run between Town Hall and Circular Quay; services will run between Town Hall and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford only. If you’re heading towards Circular Quay after 2pm, walk from Town Hall to get to your vantage point.
  • From 7pm until 4am, L2 and L3 services will not run between Central Chalmers Street and Circular Quay; services will run between Central Chalmers Street and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford only. Change for trains or metro to continue your trip to your vantage point.
Services will be very busy so be patient and allow plenty of extra travel time. For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Sydney New Year’s Eve event page.

content:

After the midnight fireworks limited ferries will run to Manly and lower north shore wharves only.
 
For more details on ferry service changes and other transport options, visit the Sydney New Year’s Eve event page.

content:
From 3pm NYE to 4am NYD route 441 buses to Birchgrove and 442 buses to Balmain will end trips early due to local road closures surrounding New Year’s Eve vantage points in the Balmain and Birchgrove peninsula.
 
Route 441: from 3pm buses to Birchgrove will detour around a section of Robert St and use a temporary stop on Crescent St before continuing to Birchgrove. From 7pm buses will run to and from Gladstone Park in Balmain only and will not continue to Birchgrove. Buses to the city will start trips from Gladstone Park, Darling St (204139). Buses from the city will end trips at Darling St at Ford St (204126). Buses will not make stops in Birchgrove, continue on foot from Balmain.
 
Route 442: from 3pm buses will detour around a section of Robert St and use a temporary stop on Crescent St before continuing to Balmain. From 7pm buses will run to and from Gladstone Park only. Buses to the city will start trips from Gladstone Park, Darling St (204139). Buses from the city will end trips at Darling St at Ford St (204126). Stops between Gladstone Park and the wharf along Darling St will be missed. Continue on foot.
 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Sydney New Year’s Eve event page.

urlText: Port Macquarie bus service changes
content:
From Tuesday 3 December 2024, a temporary shuttle bus service will connect passengers to Route 322 bus services as planned roadworks commence near Lighthouse Plaza Shopping Centre.
 
Emerald Drive at Ocean Drive will re-open, and Matthew Flinders Drive at Ocean Drive will close from 3 December until the end of February.
 
The changes will impact several bus routes and school services in the area.
 
Routes affected:
  • 322 - Lighthouse Plaza to Port Macquarie via Shelly Beach
  • 323 - Port Macquarie to Lighthouse Beach (Loop Service)
  • 333 - Kendall to Port Macquarie via Bonny Hills
  • 334 - Lighthouse Plaza to Port Macquarie
Route 322 will run from the bus stop at Pacific Drive after Waterview Close (Stop ID: 2444262) connecting with a free shuttle service to allow passengers to travel to/from Lighthouse Plaza.
 
Shuttle service will run to and from temporary stop at Matthew Flinders Drive and eastern end of Kelvin Grove via Matthew Flinders Drive, Bangalay Road, Pacific Drive and Ocean Drive to Lighthouse Plaza.
 
Missed stop: Ocean Dr at Matthew Flinders Dr (Stop ID: 2444201)
Nearest alternative stop: Lighthouse Plaza, Emerald Dr (Stop ID: 244468)

Service changes
  • Route 322 will start and finish at temporary stop in Matthew Flinders Drive at Kelvin Grove.
  • Route 323 will be temporarily discontinued and replaced by routes 322 and 324.
  • Route 333 to Laurieton will divert from Ocean Drive to Emerald Drive, Lighthouse Plaza due to temporary closure of bus stop (Ocean Drive at Matthew Flinders Drive).
  • Route 334 to set down at Lighthouse Plaza, Emerald Drive due to temporary closure of bus stop (Ocean Drive at Matthew Flinders Drive).
School services affected
  • School routes S443, S444, S445, S458, S462, S522, S554, S559, S562, S566, S567, S586, S590, S595 and S597 will also be adjusted.

Plan your trip for real-time up-to-date information.
